workflow.name: Cisco Intersight - Suspend or resume workload instance
workflow.title: Cisco Intersight - Suspend or resume workload instance

properties.description: Suspends one exact workload instance; Resume fails closed with 422 before mutation until tenant evidence proves terminal semantics. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose default runtime user can read and PATCH the required workload objects. Names are OData-escaped, Moid-scoped, and must resolve exactly once. Suspend is allowed only from Ok. PATCH sends only Action; the generic API editor has no supported conditional-header binding, so the lookup/PATCH race remains. Validated ModTime is retained only as response and polling evidence, not as a precondition. HTTP 2xx proves acceptance only, and HTTP 412 is reported without assuming its cause. Non-wait requires response action evidence; wait succeeds only on Suspended. Unknown state, timeout, or ambiguous failure requires inspection. Replace generic APIs with a supported lifecycle atomic when available.
properties.display_name: Cisco Intersight - Suspend or resume workload instance

properties.name: Workload Organization
properties.description: Exact Cisco Intersight organization name containing the selected workload deployment and instance. Apostrophes are escaped for OData before lookup.

properties.name: Workload Deployment Name
properties.description: Exact workload.WorkloadDeployment Name in Workload Organization. The workflow requires exactly one scoped match.

properties.name: Workload Instance Name
properties.description: Exact workload.WorkloadInstance Name under the selected deployment. The workflow never provides an omitted-name or list-primary-resource mode.

properties.name: Action
properties.description: Exact API action for this workflow. Allowed values are Suspend, Resume. Values are case-sensitive and no deployment-wide RetryAll action is exposed.

properties.name: Wait for Completion
properties.description: When true, poll the exact workload instance within a bounded deadline for a schema-backed terminal proof. When false, return only after the PATCH response itself provides action evidence.

properties.name: Wait Timeout Seconds
properties.description: Required from 1 through 1800 when Wait for Completion is true. The workflow uses at most 20 bounded polling attempts and never treats timeout as success.

properties.script:
import json
import sys

status = "helper-failure"
statusCode = "500"
statusMessage = "Lifecycle input preparation did not complete"
errorMessage = "Lifecycle input preparation failed."
resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
escapedOrganization = ""
escapedDeployment = ""
escapedInstance = ""
requestedAction = ""
waitForCompletion = False
waitTimeoutSeconds = 0
requestBody = "{}"

def as_bool(value):
    normalized = str(value).strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"true", "1", "yes"}:
        return True
    if normalized in {"false", "0", "no"}:
        return False
    raise ValueError("A boolean input was not serialized as true or false.")

try:
    organization = sys.argv[1].strip()
    deployment = sys.argv[2].strip()
    instance = sys.argv[3].strip()
    actionInput = sys.argv[4].strip()
    waitForCompletion = as_bool(sys.argv[5])
    waitTimeoutSeconds = int(sys.argv[6])
    confirmation = as_bool(sys.argv[7])
    mode = sys.argv[8]
    if not organization or not deployment or not instance:
        raise ValueError("Workload Organization, Workload Deployment Name, and Workload Instance Name must each be non-empty.")
    allowed = {
        "deploy-retry": {"Deploy", "Retry"},
        "suspend-resume": {"Suspend", "Resume"},
        "attach-detach": {"Attach", "Detach"},
        "unassign": {"UnAssign"},
    }
    if mode not in allowed or actionInput not in allowed[mode]:
        raise ValueError("Action does not exactly match an allowed API action for this workflow.")
    if mode == "attach-detach" and actionInput == "Detach" and not confirmation:
        raise ValueError("Confirm Detach must be true before Detach can be evaluated.")
    if mode == "unassign" and not confirmation:
        raise ValueError("Confirm Unassign must be true before UnAssign can be evaluated.")
    if waitForCompletion and (waitTimeoutSeconds < 1 or waitTimeoutSeconds > 1800):
        raise ValueError("Wait Timeout Seconds must be from 1 through 1800 when waiting is enabled.")
    if not waitForCompletion and waitTimeoutSeconds < 0:
        raise ValueError("Wait Timeout Seconds cannot be negative.")
    escapedOrganization = organization.replace("'", "''")
    escapedDeployment = deployment.replace("'", "''")
    escapedInstance = instance.replace("'", "''")
    requestedAction = actionInput
    requestBody = json.dumps({"Action":requestedAction}, separators=(",", ":"))
    status = "ok"
    statusCode = "200"
    statusMessage = "Lifecycle inputs validated and OData literals escaped"
    errorMessage = ""
    resultJson = json.dumps({"inputValidation":"passed","requestedAction":requestedAction,"waitForCompletion":waitForCompletion}, separators=(",", ":"))
except ValueError as exc:
    status = "invalid"
    statusCode = "400"
    statusMessage = "Lifecycle input validation failed"
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    status = "helper-failure"
    statusCode = "500"
    statusMessage = "Lifecycle input preparation helper failed"
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Lifecycle input preparation helper failed","detail":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.script:
import json
import sys

status = "helper-failure"
statusCode = "500"
statusMessage = "Organization lookup inspection did not complete"
errorMessage = "Organization lookup inspection failed."
resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
organizationMoid = ""

try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedName = sys.argv[2]
    results = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("The organization response does not contain a Results array.")
    if len(results) == 0:
        status = "invalid"
        statusCode = "404"
        statusMessage = "No exact organization match was found"
        errorMessage = "The organization lookup returned zero matches; exactly one is required."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage,"matchCount":0}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        status = "invalid"
        statusCode = "409"
        statusMessage = "Organization lookup is ambiguous"
        errorMessage = "The organization lookup returned more than one match; exactly one is required."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage,"matchCount":len(results)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        moid = item.get("Moid") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        if item.get("Name") != expectedName or item.get("ObjectType") != "organization.Organization" or not isinstance(moid, str) or not moid:
            status = "invalid"
            statusCode = "502"
            statusMessage = "Organization identity validation failed"
            errorMessage = "The sole organization result did not preserve the exact requested Name, concrete ObjectType, and non-empty Moid."
            resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
        else:
            organizationMoid = moid
            status = "ok"
            statusCode = "200"
            statusMessage = "Exact organization resolved"
            errorMessage = ""
            resultJson = json.dumps(item, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    status = "helper-failure"
    statusCode = "500"
    statusMessage = "Organization lookup inspection helper failed"
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Organization lookup inspection failed","detail":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.description: Requires exactly one workload instance and validates its exact Name, Organization, deployment relationship, concrete type, identity, and operation-specific preconditions.
properties.display_name: Inspect exact workload instance match
properties.script:
import json
import sys

status = "helper-failure"
statusCode = "500"
statusMessage = "Workload instance inspection did not complete"
errorMessage = "Workload instance inspection failed."
resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
instanceMoid = ""
modTime = ""
preStatus = ""
preLastAction = ""
assignedResourceCount = 0
instanceJson = "{}"
requestedAction = ""

try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedName = sys.argv[2]
    expectedOrganization = sys.argv[3]
    expectedDeployment = sys.argv[4]
    requestedAction = sys.argv[5]
    mode = sys.argv[6]
    results = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("The workload-instance response does not contain a Results array.")
    if len(results) == 0:
        status = "invalid"
        statusCode = "404"
        statusMessage = "No exact workload instance match was found"
        errorMessage = "The fully scoped workload-instance lookup returned zero matches; exactly one is required."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage,"matchCount":0}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        status = "invalid"
        statusCode = "409"
        statusMessage = "Workload instance lookup is ambiguous"
        errorMessage = "The fully scoped workload-instance lookup returned more than one match; exactly one is required."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage,"matchCount":len(results)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        organization = item.get("Organization") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        deployment = item.get("WorkloadDeployment") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        instanceMoid = item.get("Moid") if isinstance(item, dict) else ""
        modTime = item.get("ModTime") if isinstance(item, dict) else ""
        preStatus = item.get("Status") if isinstance(item, dict) else ""
        preLastAction = item.get("LastAction") if isinstance(item, dict) else ""
        assigned = item.get("AssignedResources") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        if assigned is None:
            assigned = []
        validIdentity = (
            isinstance(item, dict)
            and item.get("Name") == expectedName
            and item.get("ObjectType") == "workload.WorkloadInstance"
            and isinstance(instanceMoid, str) and bool(instanceMoid)
            and isinstance(modTime, str) and bool(modTime)
            and isinstance(preStatus, str) and bool(preStatus)
            and isinstance(organization, dict) and organization.get("Moid") == expectedOrganization
            and isinstance(deployment, dict) and deployment.get("Moid") == expectedDeployment
            and isinstance(assigned, list)
        )
        if not validIdentity:
            status = "invalid"
            statusCode = "502"
            statusMessage = "Workload instance identity validation failed"
            errorMessage = "The sole result did not preserve exact Name, Organization.Moid, WorkloadDeployment.Moid, ObjectType, Moid, ModTime, Status, and AssignedResources shape."
            resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
        else:
            assignedResourceCount = len(assigned)
            instanceJson = json.dumps(item, separators=(",", ":"))
            busy = {"InProgress", "UnAssigning", "Detaching", "Attaching"}
            if preStatus in busy:
                status = "invalid"
                statusCode = "409"
                statusMessage = "A conflicting workload-instance transition is active"
                errorMessage = "The selected instance is in %s; wait for that transition to finish before issuing %s." % (preStatus, requestedAction)
            elif mode == "attach-detach":
                status = "invalid"
                statusCode = "422"
                statusMessage = "Attach or Detach requires live-tenant validation"
                errorMessage = "The public schema exposes Attach, Detach, Attaching, and Detaching but no authoritative attached or detached terminal state or relationship proof. This workflow therefore fails closed before mutation."
            elif mode == "suspend-resume" and requestedAction == "Resume":
                status = "invalid"
                statusCode = "422"
                statusMessage = "Resume requires live-tenant validation"
                errorMessage = "The public schema does not define an authoritative terminal state for Resume. This branch fails closed before mutation instead of assuming that Ok always proves completion."
            elif mode == "suspend-resume" and requestedAction == "Suspend" and preStatus != "Ok":
                status = "invalid"
                statusCode = "409"
                statusMessage = "Current state is not conservatively suspendable"
                errorMessage = "Suspend is permitted only from Status=Ok until additional tenant transition evidence is captured."
            elif mode == "deploy-retry" and requestedAction == "Deploy" and preStatus not in {"Staging", "ReadyToDeploy", "ChangesScheduled"}:
                status = "invalid"
                statusCode = "409"
                statusMessage = "Current state is not conservatively deployable"
                errorMessage = "Deploy is permitted only from Staging, ReadyToDeploy, or ChangesScheduled."
            elif mode == "deploy-retry" and requestedAction == "Retry" and preStatus not in {"Failed", "ChangesScheduled", "InSufficientResource", "OutOfService"}:
                status = "invalid"
                statusCode = "409"
                statusMessage = "Current state is not conservatively retryable"
                errorMessage = "Retry is permitted only from Failed, ChangesScheduled, InSufficientResource, or OutOfService."
            elif mode == "unassign" and assignedResourceCount == 0:
                status = "invalid"
                statusCode = "409"
                statusMessage = "Workload instance has no assigned resources"

actions.name: Execute Python Script
actions.title: Inspect lifecycle action acceptance

properties.description: Validates exact response identity and requires LastAction to match the request together with advanced ModTime or an observed Status transition before completion can be evaluated.
properties.display_name: Inspect lifecycle action acceptance
properties.script:
import json
import sys

status = "helper-failure"
statusCode = "500"
statusMessage = "Action acceptance inspection did not complete"
errorMessage = "Action acceptance inspection failed."
resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
observedStatus = ""
observedModTime = ""

try:
    item = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedMoid = sys.argv[2]
    expectedName = sys.argv[3]
    action = sys.argv[4]
    preStatus = sys.argv[5]
    preModTime = sys.argv[6]
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        raise ValueError("The PATCH response body is not a JSON object.")
    observedStatus = item.get("Status")
    observedModTime = item.get("ModTime")
    lastAction = item.get("LastAction")
    validIdentity = item.get("Moid") == expectedMoid and item.get("Name") == expectedName and item.get("ObjectType") == "workload.WorkloadInstance"
    evidence = lastAction == action and ((isinstance(observedModTime, str) and observedModTime != preModTime) or (isinstance(observedStatus, str) and observedStatus != preStatus))
    if not validIdentity:
        status = "invalid"
        statusCode = "502"
        statusMessage = "Action response identity is inconsistent"
        errorMessage = "The PATCH response does not identify the exact workload instance selected before mutation."
    elif not evidence:
        status = "invalid"
        statusCode = "502"
        statusMessage = "Action acceptance evidence is incomplete"
        errorMessage = "The PATCH returned HTTP 2xx but did not show the requested LastAction together with advanced ModTime or an observed Status transition. Inspect the instance before retrying."
    else:
        status = "ok"
        statusCode = "202"
        statusMessage = "Workload instance action was accepted with transition evidence"
        errorMessage = ""
    resultJson = json.dumps({
        "requestAccepted": status == "ok",
        "Moid": item.get("Moid") if isinstance(item, dict) else None,
        "Name": item.get("Name") if isinstance(item, dict) else None,
        "requestedAction": action,
        "LastAction": lastAction if isinstance(item, dict) else None,
        "preActionStatus": preStatus,
        "observedStatus": observedStatus,
        "preActionModTime": preModTime,
        "observedModTime": observedModTime,
        "actionEvidence": evidence
    }, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    status = "helper-failure"
    statusCode = "500"
    statusMessage = "Action acceptance inspection helper failed"
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Action acceptance inspection failed","detail":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time

status = "helper-failure"
statusCode = "500"
statusMessage = "Polling delay did not complete"
errorMessage = "Polling delay failed."
resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

try:
    deadline = float(sys.argv[1])
    interval = float(sys.argv[2])
    attempt = int(sys.argv[3])
    remaining = deadline - time.time()
    if attempt < 1 or attempt > 20:
        raise ValueError("Poll attempt is outside the bound 1 through 20.")
    if remaining <= 0:
        status = "invalid"
        statusCode = "408"
        statusMessage = "Workload-instance action wait timed out"
        errorMessage = "The wait deadline was reached after request acceptance. The action may still be progressing; inspect the instance before retrying."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"requestAccepted":True,"timeout":True,"pollAttempt":attempt}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        actual = min(interval, remaining)
        time.sleep(actual)
        status = "ok"
        statusCode = "200"
        statusMessage = "Bounded delay completed"
        errorMessage = ""
        resultJson = json.dumps({"pollAttempt":attempt,"delaySeconds":actual}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    status = "helper-failure"
    statusCode = "500"
    statusMessage = "Polling delay helper failed"
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Polling delay failed","detail":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

actions.name: Execute Python Script
actions.title: Inspect current workload instance action state

properties.description: Revalidates exact identity, LastAction, ModTime, Status, and AssignedResources. Unknown states fail closed; only schema-backed terminal rules can succeed.
properties.display_name: Inspect current workload instance action state
properties.script:
import json
import sys

status = "helper-failure"
statusCode = "500"
statusMessage = "Action-state inspection did not complete"
errorMessage = "Action-state inspection failed."
resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
decision = "unsafe"

try:
    item = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedMoid = sys.argv[2]
    expectedName = sys.argv[3]
    action = sys.argv[4]
    preStatus = sys.argv[5]
    preModTime = sys.argv[6]
    mode = sys.argv[7]
    attempt = int(sys.argv[8])
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        raise ValueError("The polled response body is not a JSON object.")
    currentStatus = item.get("Status")
    currentModTime = item.get("ModTime")
    lastAction = item.get("LastAction")
    assigned = item.get("AssignedResources")
    if assigned is None:
        assigned = []
    validIdentity = item.get("Moid") == expectedMoid and item.get("Name") == expectedName and item.get("ObjectType") == "workload.WorkloadInstance"
    if not validIdentity or not isinstance(currentStatus, str) or not currentStatus or not isinstance(currentModTime, str) or not isinstance(assigned, list):
        raise ValueError("The polled workload instance failed exact identity or required-state validation.")
    evidence = lastAction == action and (currentModTime != preModTime or currentStatus != preStatus)
    if mode == "deploy-retry":
        if evidence and currentStatus == "Ok":
            decision = "success"
        elif evidence and currentStatus == "Failed":
            decision = "failure"
        elif evidence and currentStatus in {"InSufficientResource", "OutOfService"}:
            decision = "blocked"
        elif currentStatus in {preStatus, "Staging", "ReadyToDeploy", "InProgress", "ChangesScheduled"}:
            decision = "pending"
        else:
            decision = "unsafe"
    elif mode == "suspend-resume":
        if evidence and action == "Suspend" and currentStatus == "Suspended":
            decision = "success"
        elif evidence and currentStatus == "Failed":
            decision = "failure"
        elif evidence and currentStatus in {"InSufficientResource", "OutOfService"}:
            decision = "blocked"
        elif currentStatus in {preStatus, "InProgress", "ChangesScheduled"}:
            decision = "pending"
        else:
            decision = "unsafe"
    elif mode == "unassign":
        if evidence and action == "UnAssign" and currentStatus != "UnAssigning" and len(assigned) == 0:
            decision = "success"
        elif evidence and currentStatus == "Failed":
            decision = "failure"
        else:
            decision = "pending"
    else:
        raise ValueError("Unknown lifecycle polling mode.")
    status = "ok" if decision != "unsafe" else "invalid"
    statusCode = "200" if decision != "unsafe" else "502"
    statusMessage = "Workload-instance action state inspected" if decision != "unsafe" else "Workload-instance action entered an unrecognized or unsafe state"
    errorMessage = "" if decision != "unsafe" else "Polling stopped fail-closed because the observed state is outside the schema-backed decision rules for this action."
    resultJson = json.dumps({
        "requestAccepted":True,
        "Moid":expectedMoid,
        "Name":expectedName,
        "requestedAction":action,
        "LastAction":lastAction,
        "preActionStatus":preStatus,
        "Status":currentStatus,
        "preActionModTime":preModTime,
        "ModTime":currentModTime,
        "AssignedResourceCount":len(assigned),
        "actionEvidence":evidence,
        "pollAttempt":attempt,
        "decision":decision
    }, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    status = "helper-failure"
    statusCode = "500"
    statusMessage = "Action-state inspection helper failed"
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Action-state inspection failed","detail":errorMessage,"requestAccepted":True}, separators=(",", ":"))
